title: Fix submit button not responding in production environment

requirements.text: Fix the submit button in the Customer View page (CustomerViewPage.tsx) so it properly handles click events and saves data in production deployment, matching the working behavior in draft mode

quotes: draft working good but not live working at all

acceptanceCriteria: Submit button responds to clicks in production environment
Data saves correctly when submit button is clicked in production
Submit button behavior matches between draft and production deployments
No console errors appear when clicking the submit button

requirements.text: Review and fix event handler binding for all form submit buttons across the application to ensure they work consistently in both development and production builds

quotes: event handlers are properly bound and deployed

acceptanceCriteria: All submit buttons have properly bound onClick handlers
Event handlers are correctly bundled in production build
Form submissions trigger expected backend calls in production

requirements.text: Verify that the comment generation functionality (both single and bulk) correctly triggers and saves data through the submit actions in production environment
acceptanceCriteria: Single comment generation saves and displays results in production
Bulk comment generation processes and stores data correctly in production
Generated comments persist in backend storage after submission
UI updates to show success/failure states after submission

constraints: Maintain existing functionality that works in draft mode
Do not modify the backend actor implementation
Preserve the current UI/UX design and layout
Keep the single-actor Motoko architecture unchanged
nonGoals: Adding new features beyond fixing the production deployment issue
Changing the data structure or backend API
